item.description:

Consequently the HMOs on Avondale road, and meadiwcroft road are fly tipping huge amounts each week. Meadowcroft is most days. The council never clean those streets either. It has been over a month that Lytton Avenue has been cleaned. I do it most weeks. I am exhausted. The fly tipping on Avondale road has been there for two weeks now .
